### Tooltip A popup hint label displaying contextual text when hovering or focusing an interactive element. **Import Path**: ```typescript import { Tooltip } from "@/components/ui/tooltip/tooltip"; ``` #### Default Standard tooltip hint on hover. ```tsx Add project to favorites ``` #### Placements (Top, Right, Bottom, Left) Position tooltips using the 'side' prop. ```tsx Top Right Bottom Left ``` #### Rich HTML Content & Interactive Links Render rich formatted HTML inside tooltips with interactive links and buttons using interactive={true}. ```tsx
